May 11, 2025Raycasting Algorithm Relevant source files This page provides a detailed explanation of the Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) algorithm used for raycasting in the ts-raycasting library. The raycasting algorithm is the core component that enables the creation of pseudo-3D perspectives from 2D grid-based worlds.
